# Start from Stage 2 (upstream main) and apply the feature branch additions:
# 1. Add test-check-contains-pins to the PHONY line
# 2. Add test-check-contains-pins to test-harnesses-15
# 3. Add the test-check-contains-pins: rule at the end

cp /tmp/stage2.txt /tmp/resolved.txt

# 1. Add test-check-contains-pins after test-check-generators on the PHONY line
sed -i '' 's/ test-check-generators test-check-topology-rule-paths / test-check-generators test-check-contains-pins test-check-topology-rule-paths /g' /tmp/resolved.txt

# 2. Add test-check-contains-pins to test-harnesses-15 at the end of that line
sed -i '' 's/\(^test-harnesses-15:.*test-token-report\)$/\1 test-check-contains-pins/' /tmp/resolved.txt

# 3. Add the test-check-contains-pins: rule at the end of the file
# Find what the feature branch has for that rule
grep -A1 "^test-check-contains-pins:" /tmp/stage3.txt

echo "---"
# Verify the PHONY change
grep -o "test-check-contains-pins" /tmp/resolved.txt | wc -l
# Verify test-harnesses-15
grep "^test-harnesses-15:" /tmp/resolved.txt

grep -o "test-check-contains-pins" /tmp/resolved.txt | wc -l
grep "^test-harnesses-15:" /tmp/resolved.txt
# Append the rule at the end of the file
printf '\ntest-check-contains-pins:\n\tbash scripts/harness-timer.sh $@ bash scripts/test-check-contains-pins.sh\n' >> /tmp/resolved.txt
echo "EOF appended"
tail -5 /tmp/resolved.txt

echo "EOF appended"
tail -5 /tmp/resolved.txt

# The append didn't work as expected because the file doesn't end with newline or the printf went elsewhere
# Let's append directly:
cat >> /tmp/resolved.txt << 'RULE'

test-check-contains-pins:
	bash scripts/harness-timer.sh $@ bash scripts/test-check-contains-pins.sh
RULE

tail -5 /tmp/resolved.txt
grep -c "test-check-contains-pins" /tmp/resolved.txt

# Now copy the resolved file to Makefile and stage it
cp /tmp/resolved.txt Makefile

IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR="<TMPDIR>"
if [ -z "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -n "${IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR:-}" ] && [ -f "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" ]; then

fi
export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT

# Stage the resolved file
"$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/git-stage.sh" Makefile
echo "STAGED_RC=$?"

# Verify no conflict markers remain
if grep -q "^<<<\|^===\|^>>>" Makefile; then
  echo "ERROR: Conflict markers still present!"
else
  echo "Conflict markers: none (clean)"
fi

grep -q "^<<<\|^===\|^>>>" Makefile && echo "MARKERS_FOUND" || echo "CLEAN_NO_MARKERS"
git diff --staged --name-only
